instructions: Boil fresh Kodangal leaves in water and drink daily a few days before menstruation.
title: Kodangal Menstrual Pain Drink

instructions: • Crush fresh Murikootti leaves or the whole plant to make a paste.\n• Apply directly on fresh cuts and wounds.
notes: For external use only. Clean the wound before applying.
title: Murikootti Wound Healing Paste

instructions: • Add fresh Dantapala leaves to one litre of coconut oil.\n• Cover with a clean cloth and keep in sunlight for 15 days.\n• Strain the oil and store in a clean, dry bottle.
notes: Used to nourish scalp and improve hair health
title: Dantapala Herbal Hair Oil

instructions:
• Take fresh Tulasi leaves and raw turmeric.
• Grind them into a smooth paste.
• Apply the paste directly on the spider-bitten area.
• Leave it on and wash after some time.
title: Tulasi and Turmeric Paste for Spider Bite

instructions:
• Take fresh Tulasi leaves and a pinch of turmeric.
• Grind them into a smooth paste.
• Apply the paste gently on the affected skin area.
• Leave it for 15–20 minutes and wash with clean water.
title: Tulasi Paste for Skin Allergy
